question: Identify the names of players who, between 2010 and 2015, had an average overall rating higher than the global league-wide average for that period and also had at least one recorded attribute entry with a potential score of exactly 61.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE pa.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
GROUP BY p.XCL_122, p.XCL_123
HAVING AVG(pa.XCL_132) > (SELECT AVG(XCL_132) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE XCL_131 BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2015-12-31')
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Player_Attributes pa2 WHERE pa2.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122 AND pa2.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' AND pa2.XCL_133 = 61)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE pa.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
GROUP BY p.XCL_122, p.XCL_123
HAVING AVG(pa.XCL_132) > (SELECT AVG(XCL_132) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE XCL_131 BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2015-12-31')
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Player_Attributes pa2 WHERE pa2.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122 AND pa2.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' AND pa2.XCL_133 = 61)
